title: `ADD_PROPERTY_DEFAULT` does not propagate to inheriting classes
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 beta4

### System information

W10

### Issue description

While investigating https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108442#issuecomment-3146972777, I discovered that `anchors_preset` default is wrong for Button.

The default is defined here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/45509c284cc8779f7e791b0d7dc3d639b3cc2fcc/scene/gui/control.cpp#L4207
However it only applies to Control. Deriving classes have this default wrong, which affects scene serialization.

The bug lies specifically here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/45509c284cc8779f7e791b0d7dc3d639b3cc2fcc/core/object/class_db.cpp#L2230-L2233
ClassDB goes over all properties of a fresh instance and stores their values as default if they don't exist. So defaults from `set_property_default_value()` will not be overwritten, but only for the base class.

### Steps to reproduce

Compare the results of `ClassDB.class_get_property_default_value("Button", "anchors_preset")` and `ClassDB.class_get_property_default_value("Control", "anchors_preset")`. They should be the same (they aren't).
